doc: Westwood's campaign rooms (rules/rooms/westwood.json's index) judged by eye, each room's render looked at type by type (2026-10-05). Keyed by <map>@<x>,<y> (the room's centre in the index). keep: it is the type it is filed as; retype: its true type; exclude: not a room to learn from (a passage, a cave pocket, an outdoor yard, a story set piece, an unfurnished room, or another campaign's copy of a room already counted). filed: the classifier's type when judged. Applied by rules/rooms/curated.py (westwood.py and the room lab).
